```{r}
# States excluded for specific predictor blocks
predictor_block_exclusions <- list(
  `5`  = list(states = "IA", date_range = NULL),               # Test.Positivity
  `12` = list(states = c("MN", "MO", "OK"), date_range = NULL) # ED.visits
)

# States excluded from the common evaluation set
COMMON_EXCLUDE_STATES <- c("IA", "MN", "MO", "OK")

save_dir <- "results/model_fits"
dir.create(save_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r}
final_data <- readRDS("analysis_data.rds") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    date  = as.Date(date),
    state = as.character(state)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(date, state)

stopifnot(
  nrow(final_data) == 3500,
  dplyr::n_distinct(final_data$date) == 70,
  dplyr::n_distinct(final_data$state) == 50,
  !anyDuplicated(final_data[c("state", "date")]),
  all(rle(as.character(final_data$date))$lengths == 50)
)
```

# Fit all predictor combinations across forecast horizons

```{r}
for (wlag in 1:3) {
   for (k in 1:12) {
     result_k <- run_stateaware_by_k_checked(
       k = k,
       wlag = wlag,
       dataset = final_data,
       n_states = 50,
       exclusion_rules = predictor_block_exclusions,
       save_dir = save_dir
     )
     rm(result_k)
     gc()
   }
}
```

# Load fitted objects

```{r}
for (wlag in 1:3) {
  for (k in 1:12) {
    assign(
      paste0("comb", k, "_median_vac.lag", wlag),
      readRDS(file.path(save_dir, paste0("stateaware_k", k, "_wlag", wlag, ".rds"))),
      envir = .GlobalEnv
    )
  }
}
```

# State-specific RMSE for every candidate model (3-week horizon)

```{r}
all_state_median_results <- purrr::map_dfr(1:12, function(k) {

  object_name <- paste0("comb", k, "_median_vac.lag3")
  if (!exists(object_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
    stop("Object not found: ", object_name)
  }

  pred_list  <- get(object_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)$y_predicted_new
  combo_list <- combn(1:12, k, simplify = FALSE)

  if (length(pred_list) != length(combo_list)) {
    stop("k = ", k, ": number of predictions does not match number of combinations")
  }

  purrr::imap_dfr(pred_list, function(pred_tibble, combo_index) {

    if (!all(c("state", "obs", "pred") %in% names(pred_tibble))) {
      stop("k = ", k, ", combo_index = ", combo_index, ": missing required columns")
    }

    if (any(!is.finite(pred_tibble$obs)) || any(!is.finite(pred_tibble$pred))) {
      stop("k = ", k, ", combo_index = ", combo_index, ": non-finite obs/pred")
    }

    pred_tibble <- pred_tibble %>%
      dplyr::mutate(state = as.character(state))

    # All states available to this model
    state_rmse_available <- pred_tibble %>%
      dplyr::group_by(state) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(rmse = sqrt(mean((pred - obs)^2)), .groups = "drop")

    # Common 46-state evaluation set
    pred_common_46 <- pred_tibble %>%
      dplyr::filter(!state %in% COMMON_EXCLUDE_STATES)

    n_common_states <- dplyr::n_distinct(pred_common_46$state)
    if (n_common_states != 46) {
      stop("k = ", k, ", combo_index = ", combo_index,
           ": ", n_common_states, " states after filtering; expected 46")
    }

    predictions_per_state <- pred_common_46 %>%
      dplyr::count(state, name = "n_predictions")

    if (any(predictions_per_state$n_predictions != 50)) {
      stop("k = ", k, ", combo_index = ", combo_index,
           ": expected 50 predictions per state")
    }

    if (nrow(pred_common_46) != 2300) {
      stop("k = ", k, ", combo_index = ", combo_index,
           ": ", nrow(pred_common_46), " predictions; expected 2300")
    }

    state_rmse_46 <- pred_common_46 %>%
      dplyr::group_by(state) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(rmse = sqrt(mean((pred - obs)^2)), .groups = "drop")

    tibble::tibble(
      k = k,
      combo_index = combo_index,
      predictor_numbers = paste(combo_list[[combo_index]], collapse = ", "),
      has_hospitalization = 11L %in% combo_list[[combo_index]],

      median_state_rmse = median(state_rmse_available$rmse),
      n_states = nrow(state_rmse_available),
      n_predictions = nrow(pred_tibble),

      median_state_rmse_46 = median(state_rmse_46$rmse),
      n_states_46 = nrow(state_rmse_46),
      n_predictions_46 = nrow(pred_common_46)
    )
  })
})
```

# Best model of each size, with and without hospital admissions

```{r}
best_of_each_size <- function(has_hosp) {
  all_state_median_results %>%
    dplyr::filter(has_hospitalization == has_hosp) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(k, median_state_rmse_46, combo_index) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(k) %>%
    dplyr::slice(1) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()
}

best_state_median_with_hosp_46_by_k <- best_of_each_size(TRUE)
best_state_median_no_hosp_46_by_k   <- best_of_each_size(FALSE)

best_state_median_46_comparison <- dplyr::full_join(

  best_state_median_with_hosp_46_by_k %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      k,
      minimum_rmse_with  = median_state_rmse_46,
      index_with         = combo_index,
      predictors_with    = predictor_numbers,
      n_states_with      = n_states_46,
      n_predictions_with = n_predictions_46
    ),

  best_state_median_no_hosp_46_by_k %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      k,
      minimum_rmse_without  = median_state_rmse_46,
      index_without         = combo_index,
      predictors_without    = predictor_numbers,
      n_states_without      = n_states_46,
      n_predictions_without = n_predictions_46
    ),

  by = "k"
) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(k)

best_state_median_46_comparison %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    minimum_rmse_with = sprintf("%.3f", minimum_rmse_with),
    minimum_rmse_without = dplyr::if_else(
      is.na(minimum_rmse_without),
      NA_character_,
      sprintf("%.3f", minimum_rmse_without)
    )
  ) %>%
  print(n = Inf, width = Inf)
```
# Median state-level RMSE for every candidate model at each horizon

```{r}
compute_all_median_46 <- function(lag_suffix) {

  purrr::map_dfr(1:12, function(k) {

    object_name <- paste0("comb", k, "_median_vac.", lag_suffix)
    if (!exists(object_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
      stop("Object not found: ", object_name)
    }

    pred_list  <- get(object_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)$y_predicted_new
    combo_list <- combn(1:12, k, simplify = FALSE)

    stopifnot(length(pred_list) == length(combo_list))

    purrr::imap_dfr(pred_list, function(pred_tibble, combo_index) {

      pred_common_46 <- pred_tibble %>%
        dplyr::mutate(state = as.character(state)) %>%
        dplyr::filter(!state %in% COMMON_EXCLUDE_STATES)

      stopifnot(dplyr::n_distinct(pred_common_46$state) == 46)

      state_rmse_46 <- pred_common_46 %>%
        dplyr::group_by(state) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(rmse = sqrt(mean((pred - obs)^2)), .groups = "drop")

      tibble::tibble(
        lag = lag_suffix,
        k = k,
        combo_index = combo_index,
        predictor_numbers = paste(combo_list[[combo_index]], collapse = ", "),
        has_hospitalization = 11L %in% combo_list[[combo_index]],
        median_state_rmse_46 = median(state_rmse_46$rmse)
      )
    })
  })
}

all_lag1_46 <- compute_all_median_46("lag1")
all_lag2_46 <- compute_all_median_46("lag2")
all_lag3_46 <- compute_all_median_46("lag3")
```
